generations.name: First generation (2013-2019)
generations.notes: Conversion of the 2007 Fiat 500, built in Toluca, Mexico (Dec 2012-Jun 2019), sold in a few US states only (EPA rows; no NRCan rows). 24 kWh lithium-ion pack (usable figures differ: 22.8-23.8 kWh), 6.6 kW on-board charger, J1772, no DC fast charging. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiat_500e ; https://www.carvana.com/buy/2013-fiat-500e/ ; https://www.jdpower.com/cars/2013/fiat/500e

generations.name: Second North American generation (2024+)
generations.notes: New car on the electric Fiat 500 (Wikipedia calls it the third-generation 500; STLA Small listed): 42 kWh gross / 37.3 kWh usable, 85 kW DC (CCS1), 11 kW AC. MY2024 onward in the US and Canada. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiat_500e
